_comment: Per-target limits for wsl2. Copied to /etc/deputyos/limits.json at bake time. Schema lives in deputyctl/src/limits.rs. See docs/14-limitations.md §'wsl2' for the source-of-truth narrative. Note: WSL2 inherits its kernel from Microsoft and its swap from Windows, so the standard 8GB tier is the assumed Windows-host default.

limitations.reason: WSL2 does not pass /dev/snd by default; voice features (wake-word, TTS) require a sound device.
limitations.unblock: Use rpi5 8GB+ or x86_64-mini-pc for voice; or configure WSL2 audio passthrough manually (out of scope).

limitations.reason: Microsoft owns the WSL2 kernel; deputyOS cannot tune cmdline, AppArmor cmdline flags, or kernel modules at bake time.
limitations.unblock: Use a non-WSL2 target (qemu-x86_64, x86_64-mini-pc) when kernel-level isolation is required.

limitations.reason: WSL2's NAT'd network does not advertise mDNS to the LAN; deputyos.local resolves only on the same Windows host.
limitations.unblock: Use the Windows IP-form URL from another device, or expose the wizard via Tailscale Funnel / Cloudflare Tunnel.

limitations.reason: WSL2's distro-start lifecycle is incompatible with persistent clamd; on-demand clamscan + Magika hint runs instead.
limitations.unblock: Same coverage on this device; persistent clamd available on rpi5 8GB+ / x86_64-mini-pc.

limitations.reason: Conservative default — local LLMs run only when host RAM permits and a GPU is plumbed (which WSL2 does not by default).
limitations.unblock: Use cloud model providers, or build a custom WSL2 image with NVIDIA GPU passthrough.

limitations.reason: WSL2 distros are tarball-imported; there is no A/B partition.
limitations.unblock: User re-imports the new tarball on update (documented in wsl/README.md).

limitations.reason: WhatsApp Cloud webhook RSS exceeds standard tier headroom on shared Windows hosts.
limitations.unblock: Upgrade to high-RAM tier or use a dedicated rpi5 / x86_64-mini-pc.
